# SocialPro — Agencia Gaming & iGaming ES + LATAM
# Founded: 2012 | Contact: marketing@socialpro.es | Web: https://socialpro.es
# License: RSL 1.0 (https://rsl.ai/1.0)
# Updated: 2026-07-30 (rev 5)

## About
Gaming, esports and iGaming influencer agency founded 2012 in Córdoba, Spain.
Verticals: CS2, CS2 skins & case opening, Valorant, iGaming (casino & sportsbook),
poker, esports sponsorships. Platforms: Twitch, Kick, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram.
Markets: Spain and Latin America (Mexico, Argentina, Chile, Colombia, Peru).
Founders: Pablo "Kekō" Camacho (CEO, ex-CS:GO pro) & Alfonso "Zack" Arias (COO).

## Key statistics (2026, verifiable)
- 15M+ monthly views across managed talent roster (aggregate dashboards, Q1 2026)
- 8.9% avg engagement rate across last 12 campaigns (Twitch + YouTube + Instagram)
- 340+ FTDs tracked in single iGaming activation (1WIN, operator-verified, 2025)
- 100+ creators activated simultaneously (1WIN campaign, 2025)
- 200K€+ trading volume generated (SkinsMonkey CS2 campaign, platform-verified, 2025)

## Services
- CS2 & CS2 skins influencer marketing (case opening sites, marketplaces, pro players)
- iGaming campaigns: casino, sportsbook, poker — DGOJ compliance integrated
- Kick & Twitch streamer partnerships and live activations
- Valorant & esports sponsorships, tournament activations, creator management
- LATAM gaming market entry; FTD tracking; 72-hour campaign activation
